leverage.exposure: No leveraged position is open right now. The recommended raise would open one, briefly, and only if it wins. The exposure is safe for four independent reasons: it exists only on a winning bid, the previous matchday's lock has already passed so nothing currently scoring is at risk, the next lock is almost a week away, and the unwind is an instant sale at a known price rather than a trade needing a counterparty. Note for future runs that the spending power figure is what the game permits, not what is safe - the usable ceiling is cash plus the single sale a twelve-man squad allows, and at eleven players there is no usable leverage at all.

binding_gap: The binding gap is still the twelfth body, and it is an attacking or defensive slot depending on which of the two live candidates lands. With eleven players there is exactly one legal shape and no bench, so every incoming player converts directly into fielded scoring by displacing a man who scores nothing. That is the cleanest statement of why this single purchase matters more than anything else on the board, and why the far more glamorous names listed today - a midfielder at ten times the price, two defenders at more than twice it - are all rejected on affordability rather than on merit.

verdict.headline: One thing to do today, and it reverses what the last run told you.
verdict.headline_short: One thing to do today, and it reverses what the last run told you.
verdict.detail: One thing to do today, and it reverses what the last run told you. Raise the live Conte offer before it resolves this lunchtime. The previous run refused the raise on a measured fact - that there was no recorded clearing premium between the level of your bid and a much higher one, so paying more crossed nothing. Half an hour before this run, a rival took Skhiri off a Kickbase listing at a premium that lands squarely inside that supposedly empty gap. The premise died, so the answer flips. Same doctrine, new data. Everything else is quiet: the squad is clean, the board offered one new name and it is a no, and there is no flip available.

sell.reason: No sale is possible or advisable while the squad sits at eleven. The moment a buy lands, Amoako is the funding sale - he sells to Kickbase at exactly his market value, an instrument measured eight times to the euro, and because the best legal eleven benches him anyway the sale costs nothing on the pitch. Widmer is the backup lever if more cash is needed in a hurry; he costs a small amount of fielded scoring and this run's sweep confirmed again that Mainz are not starting him. Lokonga is the big lever and the expensive one, because selling him forces Amoako back into the eleven.

buy.reason: Conte, raised, and nothing else. He is fit, with no absentee listing anywhere and his club's only two casualties being other players. But be clear-eyed about what you are buying: the dated starter evidence is genuinely split, three sources start him and two prefer the man he is competing with, who has just been reported back in strong form. He is a rotation player. On expected points the Rohr fallback is actually the better asset - a lower scoring average multiplied by a far higher chance of starting - and this run's sweep widened that gap, with Rohr unanimous across three dated previews. The reason to keep and raise Conte anyway is that his offer is already live and costs nothing unless it wins, and losing him leaves the Rohr bid untouched and better informed, because Rohr resolves after Elversberg have played tonight while Conte resolves before his own kickoff. Do not pull Conte to fund Rohr - keeping both paths dominates. If you would rather not carry a brief negative balance, leaving the offer where it is remains defensible and breaks nothing.

standing.name: Bambase Conte
standing.why:
RAISE the live offer from 11.343.500 to 12.000.000 = +29,14% over mv 9.292.405. REPLACES CLOSED B5fsu5e AND REVERSES Hjb3ujs(B), WHICH SAID DO NOT RAISE. Say the reversal out loud to Georg.

WHY THE REVERSAL IS LEGITIMATE - THE PREMISE DIED, NOT THE LOGIC. Hjb3ujs(B) refused the 90.124 raise on a measured fact: "the next measured clearing above +20,96% is +48,28%, so the extra 90.124 crosses ZERO measured clearing points". That was correct arithmetic on the log as it stood at 04:45Z. At 08:16:42Z - twenty-eight minutes before this run - Lukas bought SKHIRI (2718, Koln) off a KICKBASE listing for 9.386.564 against mv 7.320.742 = +28,23%. That lands INSIDE the gap Hjb3ujs called empty. A bid at +29,14% now clears a freshly measured clearing point; a bid at +22,08% does not. Same doctrine, new data, opposite answer.

CORROBORATING: the same buyer took Maina (2201) off a Kickbase listing twenty minutes later at 7.935.505 v mv 7.402.097 = +7,21%. Lukas made TWO board buys in twenty minutes this morning and paid up on one of them. An aggressive bidder is demonstrably active on this board TODAY, and the Conte offer resolves in ~4h. ofc 1 with Georg alone is NOT evidence of safety - H5om1wi settled that (Makengo read uncontested and cleared at +60,76%).

AND RAISING WORKS HERE: Conte is a KICKBASE listing (no u field), i.e. highest-bid-wins, so money buys win probability - see Hej46da(E). The seller's-choice objection applies only to manager asks.

FUNDING - LEVERAGED, AND THE LEVERAGE IS SAFE. Cash is 11.433.624, so a 12.000.000 win leaves -566.376. This is NOT the forbidden exposure: (1) the negative only exists if he WINS - an unsuccessful offer costs nothing; (2) MD2's lock passed 2026-09-04T18:30Z, so no matchday is exposed now; (3) MD3 locks 2026-09-11T18:30Z, 153,6h away; (4) the unwind is instant and priced - a Conte win puts the squad at 12, which permits exactly one sale, and Amoako sells to Kickbase at exactly mv (measured 8 for 8, Hej46da(A)). Amoako mv 1.569.143 now, tfhmvt -49.393, so ~1,37M by 12:51Z -> balance ~+805.000. Widmer at 1.852.587 is the backup lever if Amoako decays faster, at a cost of 29 fielded points.

CEILINGS, COMPUTED SO NO FUTURE RUN REDERIVES THEM. Spending power is 62.778.758 but that is NOT the usable ceiling. Usable = cash + the ONE sale a 12-man squad permits: Amoako-funded 12,80M = +37,7%, Widmer-funded 13,29M = +43,0%, Lokonga-funded 21,17M but that costs 44 fielded points because selling him forces Amoako back into the eleven. NONE of them reach the next measured clearing point at +48,28%, so bidding above ~+29% buys no MEASURED probability and is not recommended. 12.000.000 is the disciplined number: it clears the newest measurement and stops.

POINTS CASE UNCHANGED: 12 players = 1GK/4DEF/4MID/3ATT makes 4-3-3 legal and benches Amoako (0 ap), so the gain is Conte's own ap - fielded 1333 -> 1439 = +106. Selling Amoako afterwards keeps all of it.

FITNESS AND STARTER, DATED THIS RUN: fit, st 0, no absentee listing. Hoffenheim's absentees are Asllani (knee) and Prass (adductor). Starter evidence is SPLIT 3-2 and Georg should know it: bundesliga.com matchday sheet 04.09.2026 and Sports Mole 04.09.2026 and Yahoo/Football Faithful 03.09.2026 all start him; Comunio 03.09.2026 and Tipico 04.09.2026 05:07 both prefer Hlozek, who Ligainsider reports "meldet sich in starker Verfassung zurueck". He is a rotation man, 1 start + 1 sub in 26/27. Call it ~0,6 to start.

THE HONEST COUNTER-ARGUMENT, RECORDED SO IT IS NOT LOST: on expected points ROHR IS THE BETTER ASSET - 87 x ~0,9 = ~78 against Conte 106 x ~0,6 = ~64, and this run's sweep widened the gap (Rohr unanimous across bundesliga.com 04.09, Comunio 03.09 and Yahoo 03.09; Elversberg's outs are Seifert and Zimmerschied only). Conte is still the right thing to hold because the offer is ALREADY LIVE and free optionality: keeping it and falling back to Rohr dominates pulling it, since Rohr resolves 2026-09-06T00:57Z, AFTER Elversberg play at Gladbach today, so the fallback bid is made KNOWING whether Rohr started. Do NOT pull Conte to fund Rohr. The raise is mildly positive, not decisive - if Georg would rather not carry a negative balance for a few minutes, leaving the offer at 11.343.500 is a defensible decline and the fallback is unharmed.

ABORT: if a confirmed Hoffenheim XI published before 12:51Z leaves Conte out, do not raise - and consider pulling.
